node.criteria: pass: evidence identifies drawn or illustrated rendering replacing photographic detail across the image’s content, including prominent subjects and surrounding areas; fail: evidence identifies retained photographic rendering with only blur, grain, or texture overlays; unknown: visible cues do not reliably distinguish drawing conversion from filtered photography.
